description: Angular component for displaying recipe details, including fetching the recipe by ID, handling image errors, navigating back, and toggling ingredients.

classes.name: RecipeDetailComponent
classes.description: Component responsible for displaying detailed information about a specific recipe, including image handling and navigation.

methods.name: constructor
methods.description: Initializes the component, retrieves recipe ID from route parameters, fetches recipe data, and sets up error handling.

methods.name: onImgError
methods.description: Handles image load errors by setting a fallback image.

methods.name: goBack
methods.description: Navigates back to the main page or previous view.

methods.name: toggleIngredient
methods.description: Toggles the checked state of an ingredient.
